summary: Added Tree.__rich_measure__ in rich/tree.py: each nesting level adds a 4-cell guide, so a node at depth d needs 4*d plus its label width; the result is the max over expanded nodes, clamped to max_width. Added test_measure in tests/test_tree.py with hand-computed expected values (9,9 and 7,7 after collapsing). Not run, per instructions. VerticalCenter does not exist in this repo, so it was not implemented; no invented class. Changes are uncommitted; CHANGELOG and CONTRIBUTORS were not updated.
